errors.text_span: 该饼图展示了三个切片
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the pie chart shows three slices, but the image clearly shows only two slices.
Following the error of stating there are three slices, the description lists three categories by repeating "AutoRG". The chart only has two categories: "半模板式" and "AutoRG".

The description fails to mention that the slices are visually emphasized by being exploded or offset from each other. The prompt specifically asks to mention if any slices are 'enlarged, offset, or bolded'.
